edits:
- [ ] **PD03 — Auth0 and player onboarding.** Reuse MP01 and the delivered MP03/entry invitation and access owners, with IDP01–IDP03 controlling Auth0 setup and logout; then qualify actual Auth0 callbacks, replay/expiry/logout/recovery, issuer/subject mapping, invitation/provisioning, two real accounts, revoked access and creator/operator separation. Configure production SES mail and provider quotas; exercise actual delivery and account recovery. Replace process-local pending-login storage before replicated auth frontends. **Owners:** MP01/MP04 and D5; **dependency:** PD01. **Exit:** real browsers cannot cross private scopes, seize another identity or obtain privilege through signup; clear failures during provider outage and restart; no authentication shortcut from a trusted-looking gateway or email match.
- [ ] **PD04 — Stateful owner deployment and CI/CD promotion.** Integrate storage-enforced ownership generations, readiness/liveness, durable maintenance/release phases, drain/reconnect and bounded termination with the current commit/receipt owner. Reuse MP03 maintenance but add the [release-specific all-writer gate](../projects/production-deployment-playbook.md#3-replace-a-world-not-a-stateless-web-replica): ordinary maintenance still permits creator editing, so it cannot alone establish a frozen capture/startup boundary. Use the playbook's stop/verify/capture/install/start procedure; fence EFS writers as well as database writes, including automatic task replacement. Never autoscale identical active copies of one world or use Express Mode's canary request split for its authority. Serialize and reconcile interrupted deployment jobs; verify running image/task definition and application state rather than only service stability. **Owners:** D1/D5, MP/SL; **dependencies:** PD02/PD03. **Exit:** creator edits/Apply and already-admitted continuations cannot cross the release gate; overlapping replacement, killed owner, lost acknowledgement, interrupted workflow, failed rollback, ALB fail-open and delayed old result preserve one authoritative history; no duplicate inventory, control or paid dispatch. Maintenance remains closed when safety cannot be verified.
files.summary: retain the missing all-writer release gate and reuse delivered onboarding
